title: An Admiral’s Rise Reveals the Politics Driving Hegseth’s Pentagon
summary: Before he was picked to lead the Navy, Adm. Daryl Caudle found ways to signal his support for Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s anti-diversity goals.
